body.heading: My Dino Cup
paragraphs: I have a special cup. It is green, and it is shaped like a dinosaur. I call it Dino Cup.

In the morning, Mom pours warm milk into Dino Cup before school. In the evening, when I come home, Mom pours apple juice into Dino Cup. At night, with dinner, Mom pours warm tomato soup into Dino Cup.
I use Dino Cup three times every day. It is my favorite cup in the whole kitchen.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Do you have a favorite cup, plate or spoon at home? What makes it special?
2. If Dino Cup could talk, what do you think it would say at breakfast?

takeaway: Careful readers can find every answer right inside the story — the color, the shape, and what the cup holds morning, evening and night.
materials: Just you and this page — no materials needed
supervision: A grown-up nearby is recommended for younger readers; the think-and-talk questions work well read aloud together.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity or materials are involved.
screenFreeExtension: After reading, close the screen and retell three things you learned to someone at home in your own words.
